spec.semantic_summary: Use huge normalization only for the two initial row addresses, then retain far pointers for row stepping, matching the target’s two AHSHIFT loads.
binding_evidence: Target has exactly two KERNEL ordinal 113 shift sites, one after each long row-address calculation.
The whole-function huge-pointer trial added eight selector obligations; this experiment confines huge normalization to the initial destination/source base adjustment.

axes.name: initial_huge_normalization_form
axes.rationale: Both address calculations require one normalized far segment adjustment, but later row steps in the target do not shift the segment.
values:
destination = (unsigned char far *)((unsigned char huge *)destination + destinationOffset);
    source = (unsigned char far *)((unsigned char huge *)source + sourceOffset);
